mintAuthority.summary: MUSD is primarily minted on Mezo through a BTC-only overcollateralized CDP/Liquity-style borrower path; the Mezo mintList (BorrowerOperations, InterestRateManager, EnclaveDebtManager proxies) and the Ethereum token/bridge surface all trace to the same 5/9 Safe, which owns the token and every proxy admin on both chains.

All three are verified TransparentUpgradeableProxy contracts whose ProxyAdmin owner() is the 5/9 Safe 0x98D889…

review.evidence: Ethereum (block 25294738, prior pass): MUSD.owner() = 5/9 Safe 0x98D889… (Safe API: no modules, no guard); three mintList entries true, of which two are dead noOp contracts and the active one is the Wormhole NTT manager (owner = same Safe); NTT inbound cap from Base = 256M tokens. Mezo (block 9611141, 2026-06-11, via mainnet.mezo.public.validationcloud.io + Mezo Blockscout API): MUSD.owner() = the same 5/9 Safe deployed at the same address on Mezo — getOwners() returned the identical 9 signers, getThreshold() = 5, getModulesPaginated empty, guard slot = 0, masterCopy = GnosisSafe 1.3.0. Full MintListAddressAdded/Removed scan: exactly 3 minters (BorrowerOperations 0x44b1ba…, InterestRateManager 0x4a4537…, EnclaveDebtManager 0x2c5e9a…), zero removals, all 3 confirmed live via mintList()=true; all 3 are verified TransparentUpgradeableProxy contracts whose ProxyAdmin owner() is the 5/9 Safe. Every mint surface on both chains traces to the BTC-collateralized CDP system governed by that Safe.
